lines: Bring a ride video along. Wattzup keeps it in step with your ride.
Below the plan, turn on Ride along to a video. It plays in sync on the dashboard.
Paste a YouTube link. Anything else is named: that doesn't look like a YouTube link.
Scrub the preview past the intro, and set where ride zero starts: twelve seconds in.
The preview adds a line: Video, synced from twelve seconds.
On the dashboard, the video takes the main view, with the plan strip beneath it.
A second tab holds Power versus plan.
Pause the video, and the ride pauses with it. Resume one, and both carry on.
On a phone, the video sits under the numbers.
What the tests prove: if the video drifts more than a second and a half, it seeks back to the ride.
And whenever the ride isn't running, the video holds.
That is journey nine. Wattzup turns an Echelon bike into a live training display.
